title: CDM Generic Instruments
description: Replaces TraderX's two-string stock concept with an instrument model shaped after the FINOS Common Domain Model. Reference data serves /instruments with CDM asset identifiers and security types, and ETFs join equities in the seed universe. The runtime topology is inherited from state 009 unchanged.

nodes.label: OpenFIGI (build time)
nodes.description: Symbology source consulted once, offline, to bake FIGI identifiers into seed data. Never called at runtime.

nodes.label: TraderX App Runtime
nodes.description: State 009 order-management runtime, carried forward with a CDM-shaped instrument model.

nodes.label: Observability Runtime
nodes.description: LGTM + OTel stack inherited from state 007 unchanged.

nodes.label: NGINX Ingress
nodes.description: Routes UI, API, and order admin traffic. Unchanged.

nodes.label: Angular Trade UI
nodes.description: Trade ticket, blotters, and admin tab. Fetches the instrument list from /instruments.

nodes.label: Reference Data
nodes.description: Serves /instruments and /instruments/{ticker}. CDM Security-shaped records with BBGTICKER and FIGI identifiers. /stocks is removed, not aliased.

nodes.label: Instrument Seed Data
nodes.description: data/instruments.csv plus the supplemental seed list. Identifiers and security types baked in offline; equities and ETFs.

nodes.label: Trade Service
nodes.description: Validates a trade's security against /instruments/{ticker} before publishing it.

nodes.label: Order Matcher
nodes.description: Matches open orders and emits lifecycle and fill events. Unchanged; now exercised with ETFs.

nodes.label: Price Publisher
nodes.description: Publishes pricing.<TICKER> ticks. Supported universe extended with five ETFs to keep the inherited alignment contract.

nodes.label: NATS Broker
nodes.description: Realtime transport for pricing, trade, position, and order subjects. No subject changes.

nodes.label: Trade Processor
nodes.description: Consumes fills and persists trades/positions. Unchanged.

nodes.label: Prometheus
nodes.description: Scrapes order metrics and blackbox probes.

nodes.label: Blackbox Exporter
nodes.description: Probes runtime endpoints. Its reference-data target moves to /instruments.

nodes.label: Grafana
nodes.description: Inherited dashboards, re-scoped to the traderx-state-016 compose project.

edges.label: Loaded and mapped onto CDM at startup
